note: Starting list for the task board. Live owner and status come from the claim server (waymo-api); this file is the fallback and the source of titles and details.

tasks.title: Set the three-week challenge and goals
tasks.detail: Scope and deadline are written down.

tasks.title: Pick the car's setup: local safety plus Kratos
tasks.detail: The ESP32 handles stopping; Kratos handles missions.

tasks.title: Agree on team roles
tasks.detail: Confirm who does what. One owner per active task; don't assume anyone's role.

tasks.title: Build the route simulator
tasks.detail: The browser simulator runs room missions with a stop queue.

tasks.title: Test Pause, Resume, Stop and E-stop in the simulator
tasks.detail: Automated simulator checks pass.

tasks.title: Publish the About page and team profiles
tasks.detail: Live at aintnowaymo.adsuaracloud.com.

tasks.title: Build the task board and claiming
tasks.detail: Claim and update tasks on this page or with the Discord commands (/claim, /done, /tasks).

tasks.title: Measure the diecast car
tasks.detail: Use calipers: inside size, wheelbase, wheel size, roof height and ground clearance. Photograph the opened shell. Earlier numbers are guesses, not measurements.

tasks.title: Mock-fit the ESP32, depth sensor and motor driver
tasks.detail: Check the parts fit, the camera can see out and the antenna isn't blocked by metal. Parts are candidates, not final.

tasks.title: Find where the battery and motors go
tasks.detail: Small 1S battery (about 200 to 300 mAh). Two motors may not fit side by side, so compare options.

tasks.title: Print the first chassis and adjust it
tasks.detail: Needs the real measurements first. Print a test fit; nothing sharp near the battery.

tasks.title: Order the motors, driver and wheels
tasks.detail: Wait until the fit is confirmed. Check the motors match the driver before buying.

tasks.title: Build the drivetrain
tasks.detail: Two-motor drive. Test forward, reverse, turns and slow stops.

tasks.title: Wire the battery and charging safely
tasks.detail: Check the motors starting up don't make the ESP32 reset, and that charging is safe.

tasks.title: Add a physical E-stop that cuts motor power
tasks.detail: Must work without Wi-Fi or Kratos and must not restart on its own. Do this before any self-driving test.

tasks.title: Add turn signals and a chime
tasks.detail: Lowest priority. Lights and sound must never slow down obstacle checks.

tasks.title: Get the depth sensor working
tasks.detail: Read real distances on the ESP32-S3. It sees forward (about 60 degrees), not all around.

tasks.title: Add motion tracking (IMU or wheel counts)
tasks.detail: Measure how much it drifts over a long hallway. Motor timing alone won't be enough.

tasks.title: Stop for obstacles even without Wi-Fi
tasks.detail: Stop for close objects, bad readings, lost connection or E-stop. Test with the network off.

tasks.title: Recognize room markers
tasks.detail: Start with two markers. If unsure where it is, stop instead of guessing.

tasks.title: Set up the Waymo container on Kratos
tasks.detail: Container running; the app runs as a limited user.

tasks.title: Set up the MQTT broker and test the ESP32 link
tasks.detail: Bench kit ready, kept apart from the real car. Measure the delay (goal: under 150 ms for 95% of messages) and how many messages get through. Not measured yet.

tasks.title: Put the website online
tasks.detail: Live through its own Cloudflare tunnel.

tasks.title: Set up the live task board database
tasks.detail: Claims and status are saved and shared between this page and Discord. Backed up on the same machine for now.

tasks.title: Lock down the robot controls
tasks.detail: Only admins send commands; guests can only watch. Enforce it on the server, not just on the page. Keep MQTT private.

tasks.title: Connect real car data and mission history
tasks.detail: Label real, estimated and simulated data clearly. Track each command as sent, received and done. A disconnected car must not look live.

tasks.title: Auto-update the site from GitHub
tasks.detail: Merged changes go live within a minute.

tasks.title: Protect the main branch on GitHub
tasks.detail: Changes need a pull request and passing checks; no force pushes.

tasks.title: Send team updates to Discord
tasks.detail: The update form posts to Discord. Task claiming replaces it once claiming is on.

tasks.title: Check the IS building map in person
tasks.detail: The map is drawn from phone measurements. Room labels and lengths still need checking on site.

tasks.title: Measure the doors and hallway width
tasks.detail: South wall (rooms 201 to 214) is done. North wall still needed. The hand sketch wins; mark unsure doors with a guessed room number and ?.

tasks.title: Place room markers (with permission)
tasks.detail: Ask before placing anything. If markers aren't allowed, use existing signs.

tasks.title: Teach the car a short hallway route
tasks.detail: Start with two nearby rooms. Confirm the room marker on arrival.

tasks.title: Test stopping for people and signaling
tasks.detail: Simulated only so far. Record failed tries too.

tasks.title: Drive between two rooms on its own
tasks.detail: Not done on the real car yet. Record failed tries too.

tasks.title: Test lost network and the emergency stop
tasks.detail: On the real car, supervised. Check it restarts safely afterwards.

tasks.title: Record results and prepare the SME presentation
tasks.detail: Videos, photos, delays, mission counts and failures. Tie the progress bar to finished milestones.
